title: Quarter-end discount expires tonight
scenario: A reseller offers a steep quarter-end discount if you sign a revised order form and pay a deposit today. The rep has worked with your company before, but the payment link goes to a new portal.

answers.A: Verify the portal and payment instructions through the vendor account team and your procurement process before committing funds.
answers.B: Ask for the quote/order to be issued through the vendor’s established customer portal.
answers.C: Pay the deposit because the rep and discount are both plausible and procurement can reconcile later.

explanation: Legitimate sales pressure can be copied by attackers or abused after account compromise. New payment infrastructure deserves independent verification.
proTip: A real discount does not make a new portal trustworthy.
